title: Going to the Station
text:
Anna wants to go to the train station. She looks at the city map. The station is next to the big park, near the river. Anna uses the map to find the way.

She checks the timetable on the wall. The next train to Krakow leaves at 9:15. It is 8:50 now, so Anna has 25 minutes. She walks quickly and arrives on time.

questions.text: When does the next train to Krakow leave?
Why does Anna look at the map?
options: She wants to find the way to the station
She wants to buy a train ticket
She wants to call her friend
She wants to go to the park
She has only a few minutes before the train leaves
She wants to see the river

vocabulary.definition: a place where trains stop so people can get on and off
a drawing that shows roads, places, and directions
a list of times when trains or buses leave and arrive

paragraph_translations: Anna chce pojechać na dworzec kolejowy. Patrzy na mapę miasta. Dworzec jest obok dużego parku, blisko rzeki. Anna używa mapy, żeby znaleźć drogę.
Sprawdza rozkład jazdy na ścianie. Następny pociąg do Krakowa odjeżdża o 9:15. Jest teraz 8:50, więc Anna ma 25 minut. Idzie szybko i przychodzi na czas.
